title: Dataform: File path description clarified
summary: A minor documentation update clarifies the reference point for file paths within Dataform workspaces. No functional changes or developer action required.
details: The description for `FileSearchResult.path` has been updated. It now specifies 'File system path relative to the file tree root.' instead of 'File system path relative to the workspace root.'. This is a documentation clarification and does not impact API behavior or require any code changes.
